sources.title: Varun Gupta
sources.snippet: Varun Gupta Hello! I am a Postdoctoral Fellow at the Vector Institute. My research interests are in sequential online prediction, trustworthy machine learning, and human-AI interaction. I completed my PhD in the Computer Science department at the University of Pennsylvania, where I was fortunate to be advised by Michael Kearns and Aaron Roth.
